name: uart-smoketest-baseline-direct-load
adaptations: Experiment-local ottf_main.h excludes FreeRTOS declarations while retaining official test configuration.
Experiment-local _ottf_main invokes test_main directly and reports its actual return value.
Platform input headers supply Earl Grey UART and Ibex base addresses.
Experiment-local log/status handlers use the official SimDV window, with failures terminal.
All unexpected exceptions and interrupts report failure.
Custom linker script places code in flash and data/stack in main SRAM; ELF entry is official _ottf_start.
pass_condition: The official test's UART configure, system-loopback, FIFO reset, polled sends/receives and every byte equality CHECK complete; only then test_main returns true and the harness writes 0x900d.
